heading: System for Award Management
text: The offeror shall be registered in the System for Award Management when submitting an offer or quotation.

heading: Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
text: The Contractor shall provide adequate security on all covered contractor information systems.

heading: Solicitation provision and contract clauses
text: Use the clause at 252.204-7012, Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting, in all solicitations and contracts, including solicitations and contracts using FAR part 12 procedures for the acquisition of commercial products and commercial services, except for solicitations and contracts solely for the acquisition of COTS items.
